details: Delta review found snapshots with identical chat/message payloads collide across different nodes, instances, callers and Z.ai account scopes. The initial separator-based digest is also ambiguous when a field contains NUL. Fixed in the current worktree by hashing principal, account scope, full node/instance/chat address and payload with 64-bit length-prefixed fields. RED and GREEN are in evidence/V093A-snapshot-red.txt and evidence/V090-V093-delta-green.txt.
